resources.string: Volume Up = one tap at your chosen spot

Turns each Volume Up press into one run of the taps and swipes you chose with the floating markers (up to 10 steps, in order).

From START until STOP, Volume Up is intercepted: the volume does not change and the volume panel does not appear. Volume Down is never intercepted. While idle, both volume keys work normally.

This service does not read screen content and collects no data. It has no internet access.
One Volume Up press = all your taps and swipes, in order.
OFF: turn on Full Auto Clicker in Accessibility settings
ON in settings but not running. Turn it off and on again.

Samsung: Settings → Accessibility → Installed apps → Full Auto Clicker → On.

If you see "App was denied access" or "Controlled by Restricted Setting" (Android 13+ does this for apps installed from a file):
1. Tap Close.
2. Tap App info below → ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, and confirm with your PIN or fingerprint.
3. Come back and turn the service on again.
The ⋮ option only appears after you have tried once and seen that message.

Recommended: Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → add Full Auto Clicker.
SELECTING: drag the marker, then press READY. Volume Up is blocked until STOP.
ARMED: %1$d steps, %2$d ms per press. Each Volume Up press runs them once. No volume panel until STOP.
PAUSED: screen rotated since READY. Volume Up does nothing until you rotate back or press START.

Tap the floating circle → START → place the markers (+ POINT, + DRAWING) → READY. The markers disappear and their positions are kept. Each Volume Up press then runs all steps once, in order; holding the key does not repeat. From START until STOP, Volume Up never changes the volume or shows the volume panel. Volume Down always changes volume. STOP, screen off, or turning the service off disarms immediately; nothing re-arms by itself.

3 · Steps (one Volume Up runs them all)

After START: + POINT adds a tap, + DRAWING records a swipe (draw it with one finger), ↶ removes the last step. Up to 10 steps, run in order by one Volume Up press. Each tap can be held from 1 ms up to 5 s (long-press). Press lengths, pauses and swipe durations are set here; positions only change with START.
